engines.transport: MCP stdio (web_fetch / web_crawl / web_read), warm server per profile
settingDifferences: network: only the fixture server address (172.31.172.243/32) is allowed besides public addresses (FETCHKEEP_ALLOW_CIDRS)
documents are saved to a per-profile store (Fetchkeep default behaviour); no HTTP cache
browser: Playwright Chromium headless shell 153 (playwright-core 1.63.0), sandbox on, settleMs 500 (default)
auto: HTTP first, escalates to Chromium only when the heuristic flags the HTTP result (docs/browsers.md)
formats=[markdown], onlyMainContent=true (default), waitFor=0 (default), maxAge=0 and storeInCache=false (fresh scrapes, no Firecrawl cache)
self-host: upstream docker-compose.yaml at the pinned commit, services api+playwright-service+redis+rabbitmq+nuq-postgres; no Fire-engine, no proxies, auth disabled
ALLOW_LOCAL_WEBHOOKS=true and TEST_SUITE_SELF_HOSTED=true (bench/engines/firecrawl/compose.override.yaml) so the stack can reach the private fixture server
formats=[markdown], onlyMainContent=true (default), waitFor=0 (default), maxAge=0 and storeInCache=false (fresh scrapes, no Firecrawl cache)
hosted: cannot reach local fixtures (marked N/A); credits counted from responses (creditsUsed) with 1 credit/scrape as the estimate when absent
DONSETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE_EGRESS=1: all private destinations allowed (DonSeTch has no per-address allow-list), needed for the local fixture server
archive=off: disables the default Wayback/archive fallback so results come from the live page
DONSETCH_BYPASS=0 and isolated cache/config dir (DONSETCH_CACHE_DIR, DONSETCH_NO_CONFIG_FILE=1)
browser: DONSETCH_BROWSER_BACKEND=headless with the same Chromium 153 build that Playwright installed (full Chromium, not the headless shell)

notes: Tasks run sequentially (concurrency 1) in a seeded random order per repetition; all engines see the same URLs and per-request deadline.
Repetition 1 is the first request after the engine started (browsers launch lazily); later repetitions are warm.
Live websites change: live results are only comparable within one run.
